title: Hamza-Shahid555/GenAI-using-LangChain-
summary: 本项目利用LangChain构建基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的应用，如GPT，通过LangChain作为LLMs与实际数据和工具之间的桥梁，实现结构化和强大的应用开发。项目涉及的核心技术包括LLMs的训练、推理，以及LangChain的架构设计和性能优化，适用于生成AI领域的数据处理和工具集成。
description: we will work on LangChain using in GenAi Generative AI with LangChain means building applications that use Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT, but in a structured and powerful way.  🔹 What LangChain Does  LangChain acts as a bridge between LLMs and real-world data/tools.
